title: Liquidators can earn extra yield by flash depositing into tranches
summary: ## Severity  **Impact**: Medium, Liquidation yields can be denied to liquidity providers  **Likelihood**: Medium, Not applicable in current deployment configuration, but valid in general  ## Description  The `liquidationPenalty` part of the liquidation incentives is dealt out to the tranches as extra yield according to their weights via the `_syncLiquidationFeeToLiquidityProviders` function. This increases the amount corresponding to each tranch share. The issue is that liquidators can snipe this extra yield at no extra cost via flash deposits.
